scope: Terminology correction to the previously audited while usage rule; no example meaning or source sentence changes.

before.usagePatternZh: 當……時／然而／雖然 + 子句；簡化子句可接動名詞；一會兒；消磨時間

after.usagePatternZh: 當……時／然而／雖然 + 子句；主語相同時可簡化為 while + V-ing 分詞子句；一會兒；消磨時間

patches.reason: The reduced while clause uses a present participle, not a gerund complement. State the normal shared-subject condition explicitly.
patches.evidence: British Council, Participle clauses: present participles and normally the same subject as the main clause; includes while examples. https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/c1/participle-clauses
